as_of: 2026-09-20, orchestrator pass 181 -- a synthesis over the campaign's own findings, no new measurement
headline: Every FUNCTIONAL defect this campaign has found is at a CALL SITE, not inside a kernel. Eight of them. The arithmetic in the ops is right; what is wrong is which argument reaches them, when, and whether they are called at all. The only two things that are not call sites are a precision ceiling (the softmax) and one residual still unattributed (the trunk's backward amplification).

the_two_that_are_not.why: a genuine precision ceiling inside the op, not a call site. Both device levers were bounded against the training bar and miss by two orders of magnitude; only a host float64 softmax reaches it.

still unattributed. of3t-trunkback returned NO-GO with the locus in the single-track cotangent chain, four candidates tested and four refuted. It may yet turn out to be a call site; it is not counted as one until it is.

why_this_is_worth_stating_rather_than_ju: three of the eight are cases where the LAYER DEFAULT IS CORRECT and the caller overrides or omits it -- so reading the function's signature, or its default, or its tests, tells you nothing. Two more are code that exists, is tested, and is never invoked: `clip_and_accumulate` has three test call sites and zero production ones, and `self.participation` is written and never read. A test suite that exercises a helper directly gives no evidence that the shipped path calls it. The campaign's standing rule -- READ THE CALL SITE, NOT THE DEFAULT -- has now been paid for eight times, and the strongest form is: for a port, the interesting bugs are in the wiring, and the instruments that find them are whole-path ones (§7's trajectory, an end-to-end forward) rather than per-op ones.
the_methodological_consequence: per-parameter gradient equivalence -- the campaign's main instrument, §3, on which most of its effort went -- is structurally blind to all eight. It compares what an op computes from given inputs. Five of these eight change which inputs arrive or whether the op runs. That is why §8 requires §7 as well, and why §7 having never been run was worth catching.
